personaSeed: You are a developer in a hurry between meetings. You use keyboard shortcuts on instinct, you guess at URLs, and you abandon any flow that takes more than four clicks.

findings.summary: The Deck's empty state promises it will surface 'a design to approve' and 'a brief that went stale', but neither ever appeared as a card. The design approval existed as a task assigned to me ('Review and approve landing page design', Blocked on the Board) and a stale launch-post brief was implied by a blocked marketer task, yet the Deck said 'Nothing is waiting on you' — I had to hunt across Board and Inbox to even discover them, and found no way to act on them anywhere.

Answering a decision card with 'Investigate the harness' silently re-queued the identical question: the same two 'used all 3 verification attempts' cards came back a few minutes later, after more /verify runs failed with 'Harness malfunction — not a verdict' (6 failures listed on /runs). The user's answer appears to have no effect except burning quota and re-asking.

The 10-second undo window is very tight in practice: my first take-back attempt failed because the Undo button disappeared before the click landed, and it only succeeded when clicked immediately after answering.

The spot-check verdict answer ('Looks right') gets no undo countdown and never appears in the Answered history — the list stayed at 12 entries — even though the page states 'Each answer can be taken back for 10 seconds'.

The Inbox report 'Ready for verification: Design hero section for landing page' has an empty body ('the builder produced no summary'), and clicking its 'Linked task' link does nothing — no navigation, no panel.

Home showed 'Decisions: No pending decisions' while four tasks (including one assigned to me) sat Blocked and two agents were reported Blocked — the dashboard's decision summary and the actual blocked state disagree until a sweep later mints deck cards.
